mapper.select: select ADD_ID as addId, sum(IF(DICT_TYPE = '1',REAL_AMOUNT,0)) as addAmount, sum(IF(DICT_TYPE = '2',REAL_AMOUNT,0)) as minusAmount from HR_SALARY_ADD_RECORD where DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and ADD_ID = #{addId} group by ADD_ID

select a.*, b.`YEAR_MONTH` as yearMonth,b.ID_CARD_NUMBER as idCardNumber,b.USER_NAME as userName,b.USER_ID as userId, b.FIRST_ORG_NAME as firstOrgName,b.FIRST_ORG_ID as firstOrgId,b.ORG_NAME as orgName,b.ORG_ID as orgId, b.ADD_AMOUNT as addAmount,b.MINUS_AMOUNT as minusAmount,b.AMOUNT as totalAmount from HR_SALARY_ADD_RECORD a left join HR_SALARY_ADD b on a.ADD_ID = b.ID ${ew.customSqlSegment}

select a.*, b.`YEAR_MONTH` as yearMonth,b.ID_CARD_NUMBER as idCardNumber,b.USER_NAME as userName,b.USER_ID as userId, b.FIRST_ORG_NAME as firstOrgName,b.FIRST_ORG_ID as firstOrgId,b.ORG_NAME as orgName,b.ORG_ID as orgId, b.ADD_AMOUNT as addAmount,b.MINUS_AMOUNT as minusAmount,b.AMOUNT as totalAmount from HR_SALARY_ADD_RECORD a left join HR_SALARY_ADD b on a.ADD_ID = b.ID where a.ID = #{id}
